n, m = map(int, input().split())
a = [int(i) % m for i in input().split()]
set_x, set_y = set(), set()

def generate_subsets(s, length, start):
    for mask in range(1 << length):
        total = 0
        for j in range(length):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                total = (total + a[start + j]) % m
        s.add(total)

generate_subsets(set_x, n // 2, 0)
generate_subsets(set_y, n - n // 2, n // 2)

sorted_y = sorted(set_y)
import bisect
max_sum = 0
for val in set_x:
    idx = bisect.bisect_left(sorted_y, m - val)
    if idx > 0:
        candidate = val + sorted_y[idx - 1]
        if candidate > max_sum:
            max_sum = candidate
print(max_sum)
